# testdata/ — synthetic JawTrack datasets with exact ground truth

Built by the *synth* agent. Everything here is generated by code (`make_synth.py`, seeded, deterministic)
and every number below was produced by running that code.

```
python3 make_synth.py                       # synth_quick/ (10 s) then synth_01/ (~30 s)  ~10 min on 2 CPUs
python3 make_synth.py --variant quick       # only synth_quick/
python3 make_synth.py --variant full --skip-calib
python3 make_synth.py --skip-video          # STLs + ground truth + reg frame only (~30 s)
python3 validate.py --motion <motion.json> --gt synth_01/ground_truth.json [--raw <raw_tracking.json>] [--registration reg.json] [--outdir DIR]
```

Requirements: OpenCV 5 (cv2.aruco), numpy, scipy, trimesh, manifold3d, rtree, matplotlib, ffmpeg.

## Files in `synth_quick/` and `synth_01/`

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `upper.stl`, `lower.stl` | procedural dentition (binary STL, mm), both **in MI, same frame** (see Frames). Watertight, ~44k / ~42k triangles, 14 teeth each + gingiva/base block |
| `video.mp4` | 1920x1080, 60 fps, H.264 CRF 18 (veryfast, yuv420p). Face-like head, HEAD board (IDs 0–5) on the forehead, JAW board (IDs 10–13) on a stem in front of the lower incisors, lens distortion, motion blur, noise, brightness drift, short partial occlusions |
| `charuco_calib.mp4` | ChArUco DICT_5X5_100, 7x5, 25 mm squares / 18 mm markers moving in front of the same camera (20 s in synth_01, 8 s in synth_quick) |
| `charuco_calib_poses_true.json` | true board pose per calibration frame (`T_C_board`, row-major) |
| `camera_true.json` | true intrinsics in SPEC 5.1 `"camera"` format (`K`, `dist` = k1,k2,p1,p2,k3, OpenCV model) |
| `reg_frame.png` | registration still = video frame `registration.frame_index` (MI) rendered with a cheek retractor and the STL teeth visible (flat-shaded z-sorted rasterisation, same camera/distortion) |
| `registration_landmarks.json` | SPEC 4 format, 6 landmark pairs; `img_px` = true projection + Gaussian noise σ = 1.5 px (simulated human clicks); includes true `incisal_point_mm` and `occlusal_plane_mm` |
| `registration_landmarks_exact.json` | same without noise |
| `ground_truth.json` | everything true (see below) |
| `motion_true.json` | the ground truth written as a SPEC 5.2 `motion.json` (for the viewer, and for `validate.py` self-tests) |
| `raw_tracking_true.json` | true `T_C_H(t)`, `T_C_J(t)` in SPEC 5.1 format (`n_markers` = markers fully inside the image and not occluded); used by `validate.py --raw` |
| `check_detectability.py` (in testdata/) | minimal reference tracker: aruco detection + solvePnP vs truth |
| `preview_stl.png` | STL previews (MI, max opening, max protrusion, right laterotrusion; front + side) |
| `_reg_frame_landmarks_debug.png`, `_video_frame_reg.png` | debug: landmarks drawn on the reg frame; the compressed video frame at the reg index |

## Frames and conventions

* **S (STL frame)**: x = patient's LEFT, y = SUPERIOR, z = ANTERIOR, mm, right-handed; origin ≈ upper incisal point.
* All matrices are 4x4 **row-major** (16 floats, `T[0..3]` = first row), acting on column vectors `p' = T p`.
* `frames[i].T` = **T_S(t)**: maps a lower-STL vertex (as exported in MI) to its position at time t in the upper frame. Exactly identity in MI frames.
* Boards: OpenCV `cv2.aruco.GridBoard` objPoints as observed in OpenCV 5.0: origin at the top-left corner of the top-left marker, **x right, y down** (marker 5 of the HEAD board is at x 36–51, y 18–33), z = x × y = **into the board** (away from the camera). Units mm.
* `rig.T_S_H` = HEAD board → S; `rig.X_T_H_S` = X = inv(T_S_H) (SPEC 3 registration). `rig.T_L_J` = JAW board → lower-STL frame (MI).
  Hence `M(t) = inv(T_C_H) T_C_J = X · T_S(t) · T_L_J`, `M0 = X · T_L_J`, and `inv(X) M M0⁻¹ X = T_S(t)` (SPEC 3).
* Camera: `T_C_S(t)` (head pose) at `registration.T_C_S_at_reg`; per-frame board poses in `raw_tracking_true.json`. The image of frame i is rendered at time i/60 (centre of a 1/120 s exposure); no rolling shutter.

## Ground-truth parameter definitions (implemented in `synthlib/gtdefs.py`, used by both generator and validator)

**Occlusal frame**: origin = lower incisal point **IP** (midpoint of the mesial ends of the 31/41 incisal edges);
**n** = normal of the plane through IP, MB cusp tip 36, MB cusp tip 46, oriented superior; **f** (anterior) = unit
projection onto that plane of (IP − midpoint(MB36, MB46)); **l** = n × f = patient's left. Sagittal plane = span(f, n);
horizontal plane = occlusal plane. All angles are relative to the occlusal plane (no Frankfort).

**Condyles** (`landmarks_mm.condyle_left/right`): average-value Bonwill points: equilateral triangle with side 105 mm,
apex at IP, tilted 22° (Balkwill) above the occlusal plane: centre = IP − 90.93·cos22°·f + 90.93·sin22°·n, condyles =
centre ± 52.5·l. In the synthetic kinematics these points are also the **exact rotation centres** (the jaw rotates about
the instantaneous intercondylar axis), so a correct kinematic-axis estimate converges to the same points.
`kinematic_hinge_axis` = line through both condyles (point = midpoint, direction = right → left), fit_rms 0.

With `d_X(t) = T_S(t)·X − X` (displacement of point X):

* `max_opening_mm` = max over `open_close` frames of |d_IP| (3-D displacement of the incisal point; the clinical
  inter-incisal distance is ≈ this minus the overbite).
* `max_protrusion_mm` = max over `protrusion` frames of d_IP·f.
* `max_laterotrusion_right_mm` = max over `laterotrusion_right` frames of −d_IP·l; `..._left_mm` = max of +d_IP·l over `laterotrusion_left`.
* **Protrusive record**: in each protrusion repetition, the (linearly interpolated) instant where d_IP·f first crosses
  **5.0 mm** going outwards. `sagittal_condylar_inclination_{left,right}_deg` = atan2(−d_c·n, d_c·f) of that condyle's
  displacement at the record; median over repetitions. `incisal_guidance_deg` = the same formula for d_IP.
* **Lateral record**: in each laterotrusion repetition, the instant where the lateral incisal displacement
  (−d_IP·l for right, +d_IP·l for left) first crosses **5.0 mm**. `bennett_angle_left_deg` is measured on the LEFT
  condyle while it is the orbiting (non-working) condyle, i.e. during **right** laterotrusion:
  atan2(medial component, d_c·f) with medial = −l for the left condyle; `bennett_angle_right_deg` on the right condyle during
  left laterotrusion (medial = +l). This is the angle between the sagittal plane and the orbiting condyle's path projected onto
  the occlusal plane over the first ≈5–6 mm of condylar travel. Median over repetitions.

## Kinematic model (`synthlib/kinematics.py`)

Two condyle points follow prescribed paths; the mandible = rigid body that carries the intercondylar axis to the current
condyle positions (minimal rotation; the orbiting condyle is the exact anchor in laterotrusion) and rotates by φ about it.
* Sagittal (eminence) path: slightly flattening curve (curvature 0.012 /mm), angles iteratively corrected so the measured
  chord inclination at the protrusive record is 35.0° (L) / 38.0° (R).
* Orbiting path: sagittal path + medial component tan(Bennett)·(forward); Bennett 10° (L) / 8° (R); working condyle shifts
  laterally 0.06 mm per mm of orbiting travel.
* Opening: pure rotation for the first 40 % (~18 mm incisal), then rotation + 12 mm condylar translation, max |d_IP| = 45 mm.
* Protrusion (9 mm), laterotrusion (10 mm each side) and chewing are **tooth-guided**: φ = max(designed φ, smallest φ ≥ 0 that
  keeps the lower teeth out of the upper teeth) using a 0.2 mm height-field of the upper arch.
* All transitions minimum-jerk; φ lightly smoothed (σ = 1.5 frames) without violating the contact constraint.
* Head: smooth seeded multi-sine yaw/pitch/roll (≈ ±9°, roll ±4.5°) about a pivot 85 mm behind the incisors, translations ≈ ±18 mm,
  nodding bursts, and 5° head extension coupled to wide opening. Camera at ≈ 36 cm, slightly below, looking up.

## Validation (`validate.py`)

Matches motion frames to GT by time (`t + source.video_offset_s`, nearest 60 fps frame); frames with `valid: false` are excluded.
Reports: incisal-point error, worse-of-36/46 MB cusp error, rotation error (median / 95th / max, overall and per segment),
MI jitter, parameters (reported vs true AND recomputed from the pipeline's T with the GT definitions), landmark errors,
hinge-axis error, registration error (if X is found as `registration.X`/`X`/`T_H_S` in motion.json or via `--registration`),
raw stage-1 board-pose errors (`--raw`), plots (`errors_vs_time.png`, `incisal_path.png`).

Verdicts (PASS ≤ target, WARN ≤ 2× target, else FAIL): incisal median ≤ 0.3 mm, incisal 95th ≤ 0.8 mm,
condylar inclination |err| ≤ 5°, Bennett |err| ≤ 5°. Exit code 0/1/2 = PASS/WARN/FAIL, 3 = input error.
Missing parameters count as WARN; < 90 % valid frames adds a WARN.

## Verified (numbers from the generator's self-checks, see `ground_truth.json → verification`)

Run 2026-11-11 (both variants):
* STLs watertight; upper 44,366 / lower 42,010 triangles. MI occlusion: max interpenetration −0.034 mm (i.e. none), every lower tooth within 0.03–0.04 mm of the upper arch (236 lower vertices < 0.1 mm).
* T_S exactly identity in all MI frames (max |T − I| = 0). Max interpenetration during motion (exact distances, ~60 sampled frames): 0.15 mm (quick) / 0.21 mm (synth_01).
* Measured true parameters (synth_01): opening 45.00 mm, protrusion 9.00, laterotrusion R 10.01 / L 10.00 mm, sagittal condylar inclination L 35.00° / R 38.00°, Bennett L 10.00° / R 8.00°, incisal guidance 36.64°. synth_quick: same opening/protrusion/inclinations (no laterotrusion → Bennett null).
* All 10 markers fully inside the image in 100 % of frames (both variants); max motion blur ≈ 6 px; 3 short partial-occlusion events in synth_01 (listed in `occlusions`).
* Video frame counts match GT: synth_quick 600 frames, synth_01 1861 frames (31.02 s), 1920x1080 @ 60 fps.
* Board rendering unbiased: detected ArUco corners vs true projections mean offset < 0.01 px, RMS 0.14–0.16 px.
* `check_detectability.py` (reference: raw per-frame PnP, no filtering, true X): boards detected in 100 % of sampled frames; incisal-point error median 0.63 mm, 95th 2.0 mm on synth_01 → reaching the 0.3 mm target needs subpixel refinement + temporal filtering in the pipeline.
* ChArUco clip: `cv2.calibrateCamera` on every 8th frame recovers fx/fy/cx/cy within 0.5 px of truth (RMS 0.087 px).
* `validate.py` on `motion_true.json` → all errors 0, OVERALL PASS; on a perturbed copy (0.25 mm noise, invalid frames, wrong inclination, missing fields) → WARN with correct per-item verdicts.

## Known limitations

* Teeth are stylised (superelliptic crowns with Gaussian cusps), not anatomical; occlusion is "touching, not interpenetrating"
  (every lower tooth raised until its closest distance to the upper arch is 0.03 mm), not a full cusp–fossa intercuspation.
* Contacts during excursions use a height-field approximation: small interpenetrations (≤ ~0.15 mm) can occur.
* Face is a flat textured plane (+ a chin plane moving with the jaw); teeth are only rendered in `reg_frame.png`, not in the video.
* No rolling shutter, no defocus, no specular glare; motion blur only on the boards.
* fps is exactly 60 (real iPhones: 59.94).
